EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A wet last week of April resulted in saturated conditions and rising stream levels across portions of northwest Iowa. This helped push the Upper Little Sioux River between Milford and Spencer into Minor flood stage at the end of the month.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: The Little Sioux River near Milford, IA rose above flood stage on the evening of April 30th with minor flooding continuing into May.
